default.description: Default permissions for the OZ-POS tablet app.

mobile-capability.description: Capabilities for the tablet / mobile app (M-1: narrowed from wildcard). The dialog/fs grants added 2026-09-20 by the tablet file-picker slice are deliberately command-scoped rather than dialog:default / fs:default, keeping the M-1 narrowing intact. The two legs of the content-URI bridge need different things and the difference is not obvious: READING the picked content:// URI needs no scope entry at all, because tauri-plugin-fs's mobile resolve_file matches the Url arm and returns before the scope is consulted (tauri-plugin-fs commands.rs:1448-1477); WRITING the bridged copy to the app cache is a plain Path, so it takes the scope-checked arm (same file, :1474-1479 -> resolve_path at :1573) and therefore does need the fs:scope entries below. Those entries are narrow on purpose -- a single leading segment with no separator wildcard, so require_literal_separator confines them to direct children of the app cache and they cannot reach $APPCACHE/images/, which is the media store BridgeCtx::media_cache_dir points the image ingest at. Three stems, each mirrored by a constant in ui/src: image-pick- by TEMP_FILE_STEM in ui/src/api/image-pick.ts, and export- / import- by EXPORT_STEM / IMPORT_STEM in ui/src/api/data.ts; backup- joined 2026-09-20 (BACKUP_STEM) for the tablet's create_backup_to outbound leg, the same mirror of export-. renaming one side without the other is a runtime 'forbidden path' error, not a type error and not a test failure. fs:allow-remove is a separate grant from fs:allow-write-file -- write-file enables only write_file/open/write (permissions/autogenerated/commands/write_file.toml), so without allow-remove every release() and every post-export cache cleanup is denied and the temp copies simply accumulate.
